references.text: Your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God - the same description of God as a consuming fire
The glory of the Lord appeared like a consuming fire on top of the mountain - God reveals himself as fire
The Lord your God goes before you; he will destroy these nations for you - the same promise that God goes ahead and destroys the enemies
God sends his terror before Israel and drives out the enemies - the promise to drive out the peoples from the land
The living God will drive out the nations from Canaan - fulfillment of the promise that God goes before
Our God is a consuming fire - The New Testament quotes this description of God
Who among us can dwell with a consuming fire? - The prophet Isaiah uses the same image for God's holiness
The Lord will hand over the nations to Israel, and they shall defeat them - the same promise of victory over the people of Canaan
